basis: User 2026-08-04 instruction to start the E3c scale and efficiency experiment (100/500/1000 agents) on a real backend.

design.scenario: Carr-S E1 v2 natural-timeline scenario (25 steps, 30-minute step, order steps 3/7, hazard 9000m/250m per step, closure step 9)
design.claim_boundary: Scale runs support the engineering envelope only (pipeline can run N agents); they do not establish realism, population representativeness, or behavioral validity.

execution_order: Mock preflight at 100 households validates the scale path and artifact completeness.
Real 100-household run (2 seeds) executes first; audit before 500.
Real 500 then 1000 execute with the same frozen config; each size audited before the next.
stop_rule: Each size stops on first ABORTED/INVALID run or fallback_rate > 0.01; artifacts preserved and excluded pending an audited recovery amendment.
cost_note: Real runs consume paid OpenCode Go quota; estimates ~$0.4 (100), ~$2 (500), ~$4 (1000) per seed at flash pricing before audit.
